hero.subtitle: We are dmm_frames — photographers from Dharmavaram, the Silk City of Andhra Pradesh, crafting cinematic visuals and authentic stories.

about.title: Rooted in Silk, Framed in Light
about.body1: We are photographers and filmmakers based in Dharmavaram, Andhra Pradesh — proudly known as the Silk City. Our lens captures the rhythm of a place woven from tradition, craftsmanship, and everyday grace.
about.body2: From candid portraits to cinematic reels, every frame we create is inspired by our culture, our landscapes, and the people who call this Silk City home.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Crafted visuals for every story worth telling.

items.title: Cinematic Shorts & Reels
items.desc: We turn your special moments into short films you can watch again and again. Every reel is cut and paced like a mini movie, with music and emotion that pull you back in.

items.title: Portrait & Lifestyle Photography
items.desc: We capture real smiles, real moments, and real people — not stiff, posed shots. Whether it's a family gathering or a quiet evening at home, we make sure it feels just like you.

items.title: Silk City Visual Stories
items.desc: Dharmavaram is famous for its beautiful silk sarees, and we love telling that story through pictures. From the weaver's hands to the finished saree, we show the care behind every thread.

items.title: Professional Photography & Videography
items.desc: We shoot everything on the Canon EOS R50, a camera built for sharp, clean, and professional results. Whether it's photos or videos, you get the same high quality every single time.
